name: School Bell Monitoring
summary: Reusable monitoring for School Bell events received by any compatible RFC 5424 Syslog input.
description: Installs a School Bell stream, exact application_name routing rule, JSON parsing pipeline, monitoring dashboard, and duplicate-execution and planned-failure event definitions. Requires an existing RFC 5424 UDP or TCP Syslog input.

description.@value: Parses School Bell JSON payloads into searchable sb_* fields.

source.@value:
pipeline "School Bell JSON Parsing"
stage 0 match pass
rule "parse School Bell structured syslog"
end

description.@value: Match RFC 5424 School Bell messages from any compatible Syslog input.
Detects more than one bell_ring event for the same planned trigger.

remediation_steps.@value: Inspect the matching School Bell messages by trigger ID and device ID.
